title: Business Analytics Bench: GetDot, Snowflake and Databricks on real analyst work
summary: Business Analytics Bench tests AI data analysts on real analyst work, from a quick number to a finished deck. We ran GetDot, Snowflake Cortex Agent and Databricks Genie on it. GetDot Frontier scored 88.0, Snowflake's agent 77.6 and Genie 39.9.
body_markdown:
We build[GetDot](https://www.getdot.ai/) , an AI data analyst. Snowflake and Databricks ship their own: Cortex Agent and Genie. Text-to-SQL benchmarks check one query. Real analyst work is a conversation, and it often ends in a chart, a deck or an alert. So we built a benchmark for that work: Business Analytics Bench. Then we ran all three on it.


## What the benchmark tests


Each task is a business user's request, most of them a follow-up in a longer conversation. They ask for a number, an explanation, a chart, a deck, an Excel workbook, a PDF, a dashboard app or a scheduled alert. The tasks run on three data sets: 90 tables, about 1.1 million rows.


About 400 checks grade the answers: 42% on accuracy, 19% on thoroughness, 27% on communication and 11% on deliverables. About one in five is critical. Fail one and the task scores zero, because a confident wrong number is worse than no answer.
